verdict.rationale: Lovable ships an official MCP server (and desktop-app local MCP support) that lets an external AI agent create projects, send messages, inspect code, and deploy apps 'without leaving the client you're already working in,' which is exactly the story of connecting one's own coding agent to drive the project instead of/alongside the built-in one. Git sync also lets developers edit locally in their own IDE/agent and sync back into Lovable.  Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence validating the MCP-driven workflow works well in practice, and more detail on how fully an external agent can 'replace' Build mode versus just issuing commands to it.
